reviews.comment:
El playero que me tocó le pague con débito y me facturó 100 pesos de más,me di cuenta al llegar a destino no lo controle en el momento,que los 100 pesos le sirvan para remedio, de seguro lo debe hacer seguido al haber tanta circulación de gente.

(Translated by Google)
The gas station attendant I met paid me with a debit card and overcharged me by 100 pesos. I only realized it when I arrived at my destination; I didn't check it at the time. I hope he gets what he deserves for his money; he probably does this often with so many people around.
